value.rationale: Wall trapping competes with persistent bulk transport and makes the variance tunably nonmonotone even when the mean is strictly increasing. The result gives a necessary-and-sufficient threshold, exact number and type of stationary points in every positive parameter regime, a nondegenerate square-root merger and directly reproducible examples. It is a motivated intrinsic exit-time fluctuation phase classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice, merely renamed mean identity or isolated finite table.
